name: approval-guard
label: Approval guard
description: Enforces the spend policy's hard rules at the platform layer, for EVERY writer: an invoice that duplicates one already received, that is over the no-PO limit with no purchase order, or that exceeds its purchase order's remaining balance by more than the tolerance can never be approved. The decide_invoice tool and the review_invoice tool already enforce this in code, but the chat agent has rw store tools and a future tool could regress. This preToolUse hook fires on any store__invoices__set carrying status: approved or recommendation: approve, and on any store__reviews__set carrying recommendation: approve, reads the purchase order and the vendor's other invoices, and blocks the write when a rule fails. The thresholds mirror amodal/_lib/policy.ts and amodal/knowledge/spend-policy.md. Capability gate (store:read) + verified caller are platform-supplied, while the policy (the rule) is the author's, owned here.
